WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0) as overspend_ratio
  FROM budget
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(overspend_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
event_with_location AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    ear.avg_ratio
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN event_avg_ratios ear ON e.event_id = ear.link_to_event
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
  FROM event_with_location
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank
